purpose: Replace type-only labels for the compact counted, gated, and wall-response family.

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ApplyTimedResponse

contract.dispatch: Shared player-collision entry for actor types 0x37 and 0x3C
contract.response: Clears the actor and reinitializes ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_RESPONSE
contract.counter: Optionally queues event 0x64 and adds 100 to ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER

evidence: Direct collision-response template load and optional event-0x64 audio

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ApplyCountedGateResponse

contract.response: Clears the actor and reinitializes ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_RESPONSE
contract.counter: Adds 100 to ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER and optionally queues event 0x64
contract.gate: Publishes the type-specific response gate at 0x00FFF179

evidence: Direct collision-response template load and response-counter helper call

contract.response: Adds 25 to ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER, clears the actor, and reinitializes ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_8D_WALL_RESPONSE

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ReplaceWithWallResponse

contract.counter: Advances the global interaction counter and adds 25 to ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER
contract.response: Clears the actor and replaces it with ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_8D_WALL_RESPONSE

evidence: Existing type-0x34 handler trace observes the installed Type-0x8D actor

conclusion: The compact family now exposes counted, gated, scene-gated, and wall-response behavior without relying on type-only handler names.
